meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建隔离工作区进行特性开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在同一仓库中并行处理多个特性或修复。
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work on multiple features or fixes in the same repository without interference.

howto.what: Claude 会先检查是否已在隔离工作区，然后自动创建隔离工作区（优先用平台原生工具，否则用 git worktree），安装依赖并运行测试，确保工作区干净。
howto.when: 当你要开始一个需要与当前工作区隔离的新功能开发，或执行实现计划之前，Claude 会触发此技能。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能创建一个隔离的工作区。
say.note: Claude 会检测当前状态并创建隔离工作区。

say.text: 我想在独立分支上开发，不影响当前代码。
say.note: Claude 会询问是否创建 worktree，然后执行。

say.text: 检查我是否已经在隔离工作区里。
say.note: Claude 会运行 Step 0 检测并报告状态。

howto.what_en: Claude checks if already in an isolated workspace, then creates one (preferring native tools, falling back to git worktree), installs dependencies, and runs tests to ensure a clean baseline.
howto.when_en: When starting feature work that needs isolation from the current workspace, or before executing implementation plans.

say_en.text: Create an isolated workspace for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will detect state and create the workspace.

say_en.text: I want to work on a separate branch without affecting current code.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for consent and set up a worktree.

say_en.text: Check if I'm already in an isolated workspace.
say_en.note: Claude runs Step 0 detection and reports.
